gates.info: Built into every build that includes the VM.
Query objects, `queryExecute` and datasource/transaction functions (PostgreSQL driver).
TUI classes (`tui.App`, `tui.Text`, ...), registered by the root crate.
ESP32 firmware functions, available only in programs running on the ESP32 runner.
ESP32 firmware runner, built with a build for the `xtensa-esp32s3-espidf` target.
ESP32 firmware runner, built with the `platform-bluetooth` feature (on by default in the runner).
ESP32 firmware runner, built with the `platform-bluetooth` feature (on by default in the runner) and a build for the `xtensa-esp32s3-espidf` target.
Lambda context objects, available inside the AWS Lambda runner.
Web server objects (`ServerApp`, `RequestContext`, ...), from the `matchbox_server` crate.

functions.description: Returns "Yes" or "No".

functions.name: append
functions.description: Appends a value in place and returns the array, so calls can be chained.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Removes all elements in place.

functions.name: delete
functions.description: Removes the element equal to the value (not the element at that index) and returns the array.

functions.name: find
functions.description: With a callback, returns the first element for which it returns true (the element itself, not its index).

functions.name: isEmpty
functions.description: Returns true when the array has no elements.

functions.name: toList
functions.description: Joins the elements into a comma-separated string.

functions.name: get
notes: Handled inside the VM; there is no global function with this name.

functions.name: addAll
functions.description: Appends all values of another array in place.

functions.name: has
functions.description: Returns true when the array contains the value.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Removes the element equal to the value (not the element at that index) and returns the array.

functions.name: removeAll
functions.description: Removes every element that appears in the other array.

functions.name: retainAll
functions.description: Keeps only the elements that also appear in the other array.
